title: Linking ADHD and Behavioral Assessment Through Identification of Shared Diagnostic Task-Based Functional Connections
summary: Task-based fMRI connectivity features in 80 participants were used to identify shared functional connections associated with ADHD diagnosis and behavioral task performance; the paper reports group-specific connectivity/diagnostic patterns. This is a small retrospective neuroimaging association, not a causal mechanism.
